
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yjgbk/p/21000688" title="发布于 2026-07-01 14:00">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">大白话解释js的class</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3><span>1. 它到底是啥？（大白话）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在没有&nbsp;<code>class</code><span>&nbsp;之前，你想造一堆类似的东西（比如好几个学生信息），得复制粘贴代码，很麻烦。<br><span><code>class</code><span>&nbsp;就是一张模板图纸<span>。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">图纸（class）<span>：规定好这个对象“长什么样”（有什么属性），会“干什么活”（有什么方法）。</span></p>


</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">实物（实例）<span>：根据这张图纸，用&nbsp;<code>new</code><span>&nbsp;机器“咔咔”生产出来的具体对象。</span></span></p>


</li>


</ul>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">核心记忆<span>：<code>class</code><span>&nbsp;不是实物，它只是一张设计图。你得用它“盖”出房子（对象）才能住进去。</span></span></p>
<h3><span>2. 怎么用？（拆解成三步）</span></h3>
<h4><span>第一步：画图纸（定义一个类）</span></h4>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>用&nbsp;<code>class</code><span>&nbsp;关键字，里面最特殊的是&nbsp;<code>constructor</code><span>（构造函数），它是“初始化器”<span>——也就是当你在生产实物时，它第一个跑起来，帮你把东西摆好。</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定义一个“学生”图纸</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Student {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> constructor接收参数，用来给新对象设置属性</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  constructor(name, age) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.name = name;  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> this指向将来生成的那个具体学生</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.age =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> age;
  }

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定义“方法”（也就是这个类型的人会干啥）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  study() {
    console.log(`${</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.name} 正在努力学习！`);
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre></pre>
</div>
<h4><span>第二步：照着图纸造实物（实例化）</span></h4>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>用&nbsp;<code>new</code><span>&nbsp;关键字，把参数传进去，一个活生生的对象就出来了。&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let stu1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Student('小明', 18<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

let stu2 </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Student('小红', 19<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

console.log(stu1.name); </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输出：小明</span>
stu2.study();           <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输出：小红 正在努力学习！</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h4><span>第三步：继承（孩子继承爹的遗产）</span></h4>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>这是&nbsp;<code>class</code><span>&nbsp;最牛的地方。如果你觉得“大学生”和“小学生”都是“学生”，但大学生多了一个“写论文”的功能，你可以直接用&nbsp;<code>extends</code><span>&nbsp;继承，不用重写一遍名字和年龄的逻辑。</span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 大学生 继承 学生</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">class CollegeStudent extends Student {
  constructor(name, age, major) {
    super(name, age); </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> super() 就是调用爹的构造函数，把名字和年龄交给爹去处理</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.major = major; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自己独有的属性</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  }

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自己独有的方法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  writeThesis() {
    console.log(`${</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.name} 正在写关于${<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.major}的论文`);
  }

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 也可以覆盖爹的方法（重写）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  study() {
    console.log(`${</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.name} 在图书馆卷学习`);
  }
}

let stu3 </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> CollegeStudent('大张', 22, '计算机'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
stu3.study();       </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输出：大张 在图书馆卷学习（覆盖了爹的）</span>
stu3.writeThesis(); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输出：大张 正在写关于计算机的论文</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<pre><span class="token comment"><span class="token keyword"><span class="token class-name"><span class="token keyword"><span class="token class-name"><span class="token punctuation"><span <h3><span>3. 三个让你少走弯路的提醒（必看）</span></h3>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>class</code><span>&nbsp;只是“语法糖”<br><span>说白了，JS 底层并没有引入什么全新的“面向对象机制”，它本质上还是函数<span>和原型链<span>。<code>class</code><span>&nbsp;只是把原来复杂难懂的写法，包装得像 Java/C++ 一样好看、好理解。<span>你不能把 class 当作普通对象直接使用，必须&nbsp;<code>new</code><span>。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>


</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>千万别忘了&nbsp;<code>new</code><br><span>如果你写成&nbsp;<code>let stu = Student('小明', 18)</code><span>（不带 new），程序会报错&nbsp;<code>Class constructor Student cannot be invoked without 'new'</code><span>。这就好比你拿着图纸当房子住，肯定要塌。</span></span></span></span></p>


</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">方法定义不加逗号<br><span>在&nbsp;<code>class</code><span>&nbsp;里面写方法（如&nbsp;<code>study() {}</code><span>），方法与方法之间<span>不用加逗号&nbsp;<code>,</code><span>，直接挨着写就行。加逗号会报语法错误（这是和 JSON 对象最大的区别）。</span></span></span></span></span></p>


</li>


</ol><hr>
<h3><span>总结一句顺口溜：</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>class</code><span>&nbsp;是张设计图，<code>new</code><span>&nbsp;一下造事物；<code>constructor</code><span>&nbsp;搞初始化，<code>extends</code><span>&nbsp;继承少走路；别忘&nbsp;<code>super</code><span>&nbsp;调父类，方法之间没逗号。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre><span class="token comment"><span class="token keyword"><span class="token class-name"><span class="token keyword"><span class="token class-name"><span class="token punctuation"><span
